capabilities.description: Order coffee for pickup at Deckhouse Coffee, a small specialty roaster. A short, deliberate menu — House Blend whole bean and a Cold Brew Kit — that an agent can read, price, and buy. Ordering is a consequential action: it runs only after the user authorizes the exact material terms on the provider page, and a material term changed after authorization is blocked. Demonstration shop; ordering places a mock order and takes no payment.
